source_instruction: i'm looking for hyaluronic acid  for skin care moisturizers.
query:
I swear I spent 20 minutes this morning chasing my tabby cat Mochi around the apartment after she knocked my entire potted succulent off the windowsill, sending gritty little cactus soil bits all over the knit throw I crocheted last winter. I finally cornered her behind the fridge, and she just blinked at me all slow and innocent like she had no clue why I was kneeling on the floor picking pebbles out of the yarn fuzz, even though she had a whole chunk of succulent leaf stuck to the side of her whiskers. On top of that, the barista at my usual coffee spot messed up my order for the third time this week, giving me an oat milk latte with extra vanilla when I explicitly asked for black cold brew with no add-ins, and I didn’t even notice until I was already halfway to the bus stop, too rushed to turn back and swap it. It’s been one of those silly, small-chaos kind of days where I just want to knock out the little errand I’ve been putting off without extra hassle, y’know?
I’m looking for a makeup remover that has hyaluronic acid in it, and I need it to be the kind that’s totally good on that front, y’know? Oh, and it absolutely has to come with a reusable microfiber cleansing cloth bundled in, I can’t be bothered to grab those separately. Also, make sure the price point is totally reasonable for my budget, I don’t want to go over a fair amount for this. Wait, did I mention it needs to work well for sensitive skin too? No, wait, no—just the stuff I said, yeah, that’s all I’m after right now.
